title: Scope the 'Every other committing session sends ... evidence to that owner' sentence so it does not apply to task-sync data-branch commits (TermAl and Engram)
outcome: In the Commit and push section of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, the sentence after 'Apart from author test refs and task-sync data-branch pushes, only the integration owner performs pushes under this rule' ('Every other committing session, including one committing directly on master, sends the commit hash and exact-input gate, review and task evidence to that owner by TermAl mailbox') is scoped to code commits under the standing rule, or names the task-sync data-branch commits as excepted, so routine export commits carry no impossible gate/review handoff duty. Found as a Low by the Claude reviewer (session-18136) of w-e7c5b9511ee3 R3 at 53baf7b8 (AGENTS.md:228, CLAUDE.md:153).
acceptance: The sentence in both files no longer requires gate, review and task evidence for task-sync data-branch commits, and AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md stay identical in that section.
Lands under the authority-file rule (both coordinators' concurrence, Greg notice, final-diff audit) as a clarification; no test reads the instruction files.
